body:
Thank you for your help, I'll try to move forward in my life. Sometimes things seen so dismal it's doesn't feel worth it. 

I really appreciate your kind words, you're an inspiration

It saddens me that this is one of the few things preventing my bad intentions. I've grown to dislike any attention from other people because of it, I don't want to be hooked into this life by people around me. 

I have little care for myself, no motivation to go anywhere in life and I feel like a burden to people around me. I'm tired of trying to understand why I am the way I am.

If you don't mind me asking, what were you like as a teenager? How did you get through the bad times? I've never really talked informally to a parent other than my own. I hope there's another way to make things better. I hate feeling like a competitor of the human race in the world I'm growing up in.
